glass_sam: Previous notes suggested dining_table_d1 for evening queries based on day 8 feedback. Day 12 feedback at 20:23 showed it at sink_k1. The location is highly variable and does not strictly follow a dining/bedroom pattern. Do not default to dining_table_d1 or nightstand_b1. Check sink_k1 for evening queries, as it may be washed or stored there.

charger_sam: Previous notes indicated alternation between desk_b1 and nightstand_b1 in the late evening. Day 8 feedback at 21:53 showed nightstand_b1. No new contradictory evidence today. Continue checking nightstand_b1 for queries after 21:00, but remain open to desk_b1 if the pattern shifts.

mug_sam: Previous notes indicated movement between kitchen_table_k1 (morning) and coffee_table_l1 (evening). Day 9 feedback at 07:46 showed kitchen_table_k1. No new contradictory evidence today. Continue checking kitchen_table_k1 for morning queries and coffee_table_l1 for evening queries.

book_sam: Previous notes indicated movement to bed_b1 in the evening for reading. Day 9 feedback at 20:43 showed bed_b1. No new contradictory evidence today. Continue checking bed_b1 for evening queries (after 19:00) rather than living room spots.

General Observation: Item locations are dynamic. Glass_sam is the most erratic, appearing at dining_table_d1, nightstand_b1, and sink_k1. Prioritize recent feedback. For evening queries, check sink_k1 for glass_sam, nightstand_b1 for charger_sam, coffee_table_l1 for mug_sam, and bed_b1 for book_sam. Avoid assuming static locations for glass_sam.
